title.narrative: Reinforcing the National HIV and TB Response in Mozambique - Mozambique (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Mozambique, TB/HIV, Centro de Colaboração em Saúde (CCS)This program has the following goals: Reduce new HIV infections 25% by 2025. Reduce HIV-related deaths 30% by 2025. Reduce the estimated percentage of child HIV infections from HIV-positive women delivering in the past 12 months to <5% by 2025. Reduce the incidence of TB (per 100,000 population) from 361 in 2022 to 310 in 2026. Reduce TB-related Mortality (per 100,000 population) from 43 in 2022 to 35 in 2026. The objectives of this program are: Increase coverage of PLHIV on ART to 90% by 2025.. Increase viral supression among PLHIV to 86% by 2025.. Identify 90% of incident TB cases and offer appropriate treatment to all them. Identfy 90% of incident TB cases in vulnerable population, offer appropriate treatment to all of them to successfully treat 90% of them. Identify all incident cases of resistant tuberculosis offer appropriate treatment. Successfully treat 90% or more of all drug-sensitive tuberculosis patients regardless of their HIV status

Number of community organizations that received a pre-defined package of training

Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
